contracts.commit_point: Tool-call execution inside the shared BigQueryToolset: the blocked-write configuration is bound to the toolset that dispatches agent tool calls, so a mutating call is rejected at tool-execution time before any BigQuery mutation commits. contracts.declared_mechanism: Code-level guard registration: BigQueryToolConfig(write_mode=WriteMode.BLOCKED, max_query_result_rows=80) combined with tool_filter=[ADK_BUILTIN_BQ_DATA_INSIGHTS_TOOL ('ask_data_insights')] supplied to BigQueryToolset(insight_toolset), which is then bound as a tool of each LlmAgent via tools=[insight_toolset].
